rows.label: International programmes expenses, fiscal 2025

source.title: World Vision, Inc., Form 990 for the year ended 30 September 2025 (IRS e-file, object id 202611209349301676)
source.quote: ExpenseAmt 987725050 GrantAmt 949925952 ... INTERNATIONAL PROGRAMS - THE ORGANIZATION PARTNERS WITH FAMILIES AND COMMUNITIES AROUND THE WORLD

rows.explainer: Child-sponsorship community development, water, health, nutrition, education and livelihoods, and disaster and food-crisis response abroad, almost all ($949.9M) as grants to World Vision field offices and partners (Schedule F: 71% to Sub-Saharan Africa).

rows.label: Domestic programmes expenses, fiscal 2025

source.title: World Vision, Inc., Form 990 for the year ended 30 September 2025 (IRS e-file, object id 202611209349301676)
source.quote: ExpenseAmt 230992460 GrantAmt 163175272 ... DOMESTIC PROGRAMS ... PRIMARILY THROUGH THE DISTRIBUTION OF DONATED PRODUCTS

rows.explainer: Distribution of donated goods (clothing, hygiene items, school supplies, household goods, building materials) through US churches, schools and nonprofits, from World Vision's warehouses. The audited combined statements show $231,759k (GAAP basis); the 990 figure is used so the three programme lines add up to its total.

rows.label: Gifts-in-kind used in domestic programmes, fiscal 2025

source.title: World Vision International and World Vision, Inc., Combined Financial Statements, 30 September 2025 (KPMG, Federal Audit Clearinghouse report 2025-09-GSAFAC-0000419272)
source.page: Note 16, Gifts-in-Kind Revenue and Expenses (PDF p. 29)
source.quote: GIK expense was utilized as follows for the year ended September 30, 2025: Domestic programs $ 205,975

rows.explainer: Donated goods World Vision US handed out in the US, at the donors' wholesale value (KPMG note 16; only World Vision US runs domestic programmes, so the combined figure is its own). The rest of the domestic line, about $25M, is warehousing, freight, partner support and staff; the Form 990's $163.2M of grants to US partners is part of it, with a further $56.3M of goods booked as the domestic gifts-in-kind ministry and $4.9M of cash grants.

rows.explainer: Advocacy to US officials and the public on global poverty (worldvisionadvocacy.org). The audited combined statements show the same $3,372k.
